title: Anti-Q
description: With this plugin, you now dont have to deal with accidently dropping your items down while in a fight or generally just doing anything...
body:
**_Tired of accidently dropping your valuables in a fight or just out of nowhere? Well let us fix that!_**

### **Anti-Q:**
- Extra step verification on dropping valuables (Double clicking).
- Custom config to decide what kind of items are counted as "Valuables".

_My first ever plugin, hope you enjoy!_
